rationale: Executive Order 8774 (June 10, 1941; 6 FR 2845) permits entry of coffee from non-signatory countries up to the unfilled balance of the quota for the quota year ending September 30, 1941. The permission is bounded by the order's own text to that quota year, so it ended on September 30, 1941 (inclusive; the exclusive reading is October 1, 1941). The own-terms record TERM:EO:8774:a13b6f78bd3acad8@9bd71c94e695436b quotes that wording from the held Federal Register original. The single catalog observation (Amends: EO 8738, April 21, 1941) names the order this one modified and records no later action on EO 8774. The status rests on the order's own terms: it has no operative force on 2026-10-14.
